answer: We establish information-theoretic unforgeability by fusing recursive zero-knowledge STARK reputation commitments with sequential delay functions to forge an immutable ridge of identity proof. The unique digital pigment of each actor anchors state, preventing spoofing as the cold copper of cryptographic finality binds proof to sequential computation. This obfuscation renders identity cloning infeasible, as independent autonomous agents cannot solve the sequential delay functions required to forge valid proof without compromising the core cryptographic commitments.
